# The cross-over of verify_truncate_orphan_merge_workflow.txt turned against
# itself: the mainline HAD a vault, its log is deleted, and a merge brings back
# an older log from a branch. Crossing over into that branch would skip the
# entries only the mainline held. A side that descends from the init commit had
# a vault, so its missing log is a deletion and has to be reported.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init'
exec git branch side

# Entries only the mainline holds.
exec sesam add s.txt --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add secret'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'

# The hooks go from here on: without a log there is no vault for them to load.
exec sesam hook uninstall

# Delete the log on the mainline.
exec git rm -q .sesam/audit/log.jsonl
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'drop log'

# The side branch moves on without touching the vault.
exec git switch side
exec git commit --allow-empty --no-verify -m 'side work'
exec git switch -

# Merge it, and put the side's older log into the merge commit.
exec git merge --no-ff --no-edit side
exec git show side:.sesam/audit/log.jsonl
cp stdout .sesam/audit/log.jsonl
exec git add -f .sesam/audit/log.jsonl
exec git commit --amend --no-verify --no-edit

# no-disk isolates the history check from the on-disk mismatches.
! exec sesam --verify-mode no-disk verify --truncate
stderr 'audit log was removed from history'

-- s.txt --
top secret
